skills.description: Control and inspect the local agy-steer Codex-style mid-turn steering queue, launch the floating input box, or verify PreInvocation hook delivery. Use when the user asks to open agy-steer, inspect/queue/clear steering messages, or test whet

# agy-steer **Codex-style mid-turn steering for the Google Antigravity desktop app.** Type while the agent works — your message is injected into the *running* turn before the next model call. No Stop button, no lost tool work. [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Windows%20%7C%20macOS%20%7C%20Linux-lightgrey)]() [![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A518-339933)]() [![Zero deps](https://img.shields.io/badge/dependencies-0-success)]() [English](#english) · [简体中文](#简体中文)
> ⚠️ **Unofficial community project.** Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Google. "Antigravity" and "Gemini" are trademarks of Google LLC, used here only to indicate compatibility. --- ## English ### The problem In the Antigravity desktop app, when the agent goes down the wrong path you have to **Stop the turn, retype, and restart** — in-flight tool work is discarded and the agent loses momentum. Codex CLI solved this with *steering*: messages you type mid-turn are queued and injected after the next tool call, without cancelling anything. The Antigravity CLI got a native `Queued Messages → Send Immediately` option (v1.2.14+), but the **desktop app still has no smooth steering UX**. `agy-steer` adds it as a plugin: - 🪟 **Floating input box** — a small always-on-top-capable window (`Auto` / `Light` / `Dark` themes, `中文` / `EN`) that lives beside Antigravity. Type and press Enter. - ⚡ **Mid-turn injection** — a `PreInvocation` hook fires before *every model call*; pending messages are returned as `injectSteps` (`userMessage` or `systemMessage`) and appended to the current turn. - 🎯 **Global or per-conversation scoping** — broadcast to whichever active turn runs next, or pin messages to a specific conversation ID when juggling multiple chats. - 📋 **Codex-like queue** — preview, reorder (`↑`/`↓`), edit (with `↑` quick-edit), hold/resume, delete, clear, or reuse previously injected prompts. - 🧩 **Native Antigravity Skill** — ask the agent directly in chat to open the floating box, inspect the queue, or verify hook delivery. - 🔒 **100% local & CSRF-hardened** — daemon binds `127.0.0.1` only, validates `Host` / `Origin` / `Sec-Fetch-Site` / `Content-Type` to prevent cross-origin prompt injection from browser tabs, zero external dependencies, zero telemetry. ### How it works ```mermaid flowchart LR UI["Floating input box
(ui/index.html)"] -->|"POST /enqueue"| D["Local daemon
127.0.0.1:47833"] AG["Antigravity agent"] -->|"PreInvocation hook
(before each model call)"| R["hook-relay.mjs"] R -->|"POST /relay/take"| D R -->|"stdout: injectSteps"| AG AG -->|"injected step appended
to the RUNNING turn"| AG ``` The injection mechanism (`PreInvocation` → `{"injectSteps":[{"userMessage":"..."}]}`) is the same one used by the [Multica project](https://github.com/multica-ai/multica/pull/11200) to steer `agy` turns, and follows Antigravity's documented [hooks system](https://codelabs.developers.google.com/harness-engineering-antigravity). ### ⚠️ Status & honest limitations | Item | Status | |---|---| | Queue daemon + relay + UI + security guards | ✅ implemented, covered by `tests/simulate.mjs` | | `injectSteps` accepted by **agy CLI** (`-p` mode) | ✅ verified by Multica (external project) | | `injectSteps` accepted by the **desktop app** | 🔶 **needs a 2-minute check on your machine — see [docs/VERIFY.md](docs/VERIFY.md). Do this first.** | - **Injection granularity is the model-call boundary.** A long-running shell command finishes first; your message lands right after. This matches Codex semantics ("after next tool call"). A true instant kill is still the native **Stop** button — this plugin deliberately does *not* cancel turns. - **Turn-start race is handled by design**: messages stay in the daemon queue (persisted atomically to disk) until an eligible hook actually takes them, so nothing is lost during turn startup or daemon restarts. - **Hooks never break the agent**: every relay error path prints `{}` and exits `0`, staying comfortably under the 3s hook timeout even on cold daemon auto-spawn. ### Install Requirements: Antigravity desktop app (installed & launched once), and Node.js ≥ 18 on `PATH` — on Windows, Antigravity's bundled `agy-node.cmd` / `Antigravity.exe` is detected automatically with zero extra Node install (or set `AGY_STEER_NODE`). **Windows** ```powershell git clone https://github.com/cxtsnd6/agy-steer.git cd agy-steer powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1 ``` **macOS / Linux** ```bash git clone https://github.com/cxtsnd6/agy-steer.git cd agy-steer sh ./install.sh ``` The installer copies the plugin to `~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-steer/`, generates a space-safe node shim if `node` is not on `PATH`, restarts any older daemon cleanly, and opens the floating box. **Restart Antigravity** so it loads `hooks.json`, then run [docs/VERIFY.md](docs/VERIFY.md). ### Usage 1. Start a task in Antigravity. 2. While the agent works, type into the floating box and press **Enter** (`Shift+Enter` for newline, `↑` when empty to edit the last queued message). 3. Choose **Any active turn (global)** or pin to a specific conversation; pick `userMessage` (default) or `systemMessage`. 4. The message sits in **Pending** until the next model call, then moves to **Injected** with timestamp & conversation info. 5. Change your mind? **reorder / hold / edit / delete** any pending message before it is taken, or **reuse** any injected message later. Re-open the box anytime: ```powershell powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\launch-ui.ps1 -Pin # Windows, -Pin = always-on-top (best effort) ``` ```bash sh ./scripts/launch-ui.sh # macOS / Linux ``` ### Uninstall ```powershell powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\uninstall.ps1 # add -Purge to also delete queue data ``` ```bash sh ./uninstall.sh # add --purge likewise ``` ### Repository layout ```text agy-steer/ ├── plugin.json # Antigravity plugin manifest ├── hooks.json # SessionStart / PreInvocation / Stop bindings ├── package.json # Zero-dependency Node metadata & npm test script ├── skills/agy-steer/SKILL.md # Native Antigravity skill for suggestedPrompts & queue control ├── scripts/ │ ├── daemon.mjs # Local queue + CSRF-guarded HTTP API + UI host │ ├── hook-relay.mjs # Hook entry: take eligible messages → print injectSteps │ └── launch-ui.ps1/.sh # Open the floating box (app-mode window) ├── ui/index.html # Bilingual (zh/en) & themed floating steer box ├── tests/simulate.mjs # End-to-end simulation & security test suite ├── docs/ │ ├── VERIFY.md # 2-minute desktop-app acceptance check │ └── PUBLISHING.md # Release & publishing checklist ├── install.ps1/.sh # Cross-platform installers └── uninstall.ps1/.sh # Cross-platform uninstallers ``` ### Roadmap - [x] Per-conversation message scoping - [x] Light / Dark / Auto theme adaptation & CSRF protection - [ ] Global hotkey to summon the box (native helper) - [ ] "Stop & resend" hard-interrupt fallback (explicit opt-in) - [ ] Desktop-pet companion skin (queue bubbles on your waifu) - [ ] Plugin Marketplace listing ### Contributing & License See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). Licensed under [MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 agy-steer contributors. --- ## 简体中文 ### 解决什么问题 Antigravity 桌面版里，Agent 跑偏时你只能**点 Stop、重新打字、重开回合**——在途的工具执行被丢弃，节奏全断。Codex CLI 早就用 *steering（转向）* 解决了这件事：运行中直接打字，消息排队并在下一次工具调用后注入当前回合，不取消任何东西。Antigravity CLI 在 1.2.14 后也原生支持了（`Queued Messages → Send Immediately`），但**桌面 App 一直没有顺手的转向入口**。 `agy-steer` 用插件把它补上： - 🪟 **悬浮输入框**：挂在 Antigravity 旁边的小窗（支持自动/浅色/深色主题、中英文切换），随时打字、回车即排队； - ⚡ **回合内注入**：`PreInvocation` hook 在每次模型调用前触发，把待注入消息以 `injectSteps`（支持 `userMessage` / `systemMessage`）追加进正在运行的回合； - 🎯 **全局或按会话定向**：既可默认注入下一个活跃回合，也可在多窗口并行时锁定指定会话 ID； - 📋 **Codex 同款队列**：支持预览、调整顺序（`↑`/`↓`）、行内编辑（空框按 `↑` 快编末条）、暂停/恢复、删除、清空与历史消息一键复用； - 🧩 **内置 Antigravity Skill**：可在聊天里直接让 Agent 帮你打开悬浮窗、查看待注入队列或辅助验证 Hook； - 🔒 **纯本地 + 防跨站注入**：仅监听 `127.0.0.1`，校验 `Host` / `Origin` / `Sec-Fetch-Site` / `Content-Type` 防止网页 CSRF 注入恶意指令；零外部依赖、零遥测。 ### ⚠️ 现状与诚实的边界 - 队列守护进程 + hook 中继 + UI + 安全校验已实现，并有 `tests/simulate.mjs` 自动化测试覆盖； - `injectSteps` 机制在 **agy CLI（`-p` 模式）** 上已被 [Multica 项目](https://github.com/multica-ai/multica/pull/11200) 验证；**桌面 App 是否同样接受，请先花 2 分钟按 [docs/VERIFY.md](docs/VERIFY.md) 在你的机器上确认**——这是使用前的第一步； - **注入粒度是模型调用边界**：正在跑的长命令会先跑完，消息随后落地（与 Codex 语义一致）。真正的“立刻掐断”仍是原生 Stop，本插件刻意不取消回合； - 回合启动空窗期或守护进程重启都不会丢消息：消息通过原子写持久化在本地队列，直到符合条件的 hook 真正取走； - hook 永不拖累 Agent：中继任何异常都输出 `{}` 并以 0 退出，冷启动也能控制在 3 秒超时以内。 ### 安装 前提：已安装并启动过一次 Antigravity 桌面版；PATH 里有 Node.js ≥ 18（Windows 下即使未单独装 Node，安装器也会自动探测 Antigravity 自带的 `agy-node.cmd` / `Antigravity.exe`，或通过 `AGY_STEER_NODE` 指定）。 **Windows** ```powershell git clone https://github.com/cxtsnd6/agy-steer.git cd agy-steer powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1 ``` **macOS / Linux** ```bash git clone https://github.com/cxtsnd6/agy-steer.git cd agy-steer sh ./install.sh ``` 安装器会把插件复制到 `~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-steer/`，若 `node` 不在默认 `PATH` 会自动生成免空格跳板脚本，平滑重启旧版守护进程并打开悬浮框。**重启 Antigravity** 让 `hooks.json` 生效，然后跑一遍 [docs/VERIFY.md](docs/VERIFY.md)。 ### 使用 1. 在 Antigravity 里发起任务； 2. Agent 干活时直接在悬浮框打字，**Enter** 发送（`Shift+Enter` 换行；输入框为空时按 `↑` 快速编辑最后一条待注入消息）； 3. 可选择「任意活跃回合（全局）」或定向到某个会话，以及选择 `userMessage`（默认）或 `systemMessage`； 4. 消息先进入「待注入」，下一次模型调用前被取走，移入「已注入」并记录时间戳、工作区与会话 ID； 5. 反悔了？注入前随时**调序 / 暂停 / 编辑 / 删除**，也可从历史里一键**复用**。 随时重新打开悬浮框： ```powershell powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\launch-ui.ps1 -Pin # Windows，-Pin 尝试置顶 ``` ```bash sh ./scripts/launch-ui.sh # macOS / Linux ``` ### 卸载 ```powershell powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\uninstall.ps1 # 加 -Purge 连队列数据一起删 ``` ```bash sh ./uninstall.sh # 加 --purge 同理 ``` ### 路线图 - [x] 按会话定向注入 - [x] 浅色 / 深色 / 自动主题适配 & 本地 CSRF 防护 - [ ] 全局热键唤出输入框（原生小助手） - [ ] “Stop 并带新指令重发”的硬打断兜底（显式开启） - [ ] 桌宠联动皮肤（待注入消息变成她头顶的气泡） - [ ] 上架官方插件市场 ### 免责声明 本项目为**非官方社区同人项目**，与 Google 无隶属、背书或赞助关系。“Antigravity”、“Gemini” 为 Google LLC 的商标，此处仅用于指明适配对象。项目不含任何官方素材，请勿用于商标侵权行为。 ### 开源协议 [MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 agy-steer contributors

# Changelog

## 0.2.0 (2026-11-24)

Major reliability, security, and UX upgrade ahead of open-source launch:

- **Windows zero-config runtime resolution**: `install.ps1` and `scripts/launch-ui.ps1` now detect Antigravity's `%APPDATA%\Antigravity\bin\agy-node.cmd` and `Antigravity.exe` (`ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1`), generating a space-safe `scripts\run-node.cmd` shim when `node` is not on `PATH` and ensuring hidden background spawning with `windowsHide`.
- **CSRF & local security hardening**: `daemon.mjs` now validates `Host`, `Origin`, `Sec-Fetch-Site`, and `Content-Type: application/json` on mutating endpoints to block cross-origin prompt-injection attempts from browser tabs, fixes static path traversal boundary checks, and writes `state.json` atomically.
- **Per-conversation scoping & step modes**: route messages to any active turn (global) or pin them to a specific `conversationId`, and choose between `userMessage` and `systemMessage` `injectSteps`.
- **Floating UI improvements**: fixed the 1-second poll overwriting active inline edits, added revision-based DOM updates, light/dark/auto theme switching, queue reordering (`↑`/`↓`), clear queue/history controls, one-click history reuse, `ArrowUp` quick-edit, and live invocation/hook-age diagnostics.
- **Native Antigravity Skill**: added `skills/agy-steer/SKILL.md` and updated `plugin.json` `suggestedPrompts` so the agent can directly open the box, inspect the queue, and assist with verification.
- **Expanded tests & contributor docs**: added `package.json`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `.gitattributes`, issue templates, and expanded `tests/simulate.mjs` coverage (14 checks).
